Checking the whole text: the only lower-bound content is the 'Current best' conjecture, which analyzes only one specific Xiang reply (marking all remaining grid points, giving equal pieces), not arbitrary replies; the 'Full proof' section says '(To be completed)'. No pairing, majorization, tree, or induction argument valid for all n against every legal Xiang reply appears anywhere. Moreover the conjectured value (n+1)/(2n+1) is not the correct 2^n/(2^(n+1)-1) for n>=2. The objection correctly identifies that the all-n lower-bound obligation is entirely unmet, and since it is a load-bearing half of the required proof, the write-up remains incomplete.
